data.name: Hajurah
data.gender_notes: Hajurah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'hajarah', meaning 'pilgrim'. This name signifies a woman who is deeply devoted to her faith and has made the journey to the Holy Land of Mecca to perform the Hajj pilgrimage. It is a name that embodies the virtues of righteousness, perseverance, and spiritual growth. The name Hajurah carries the meaning “Pious, devout, pilgrim” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hajurah usually hope their child will grow to embody pious, devout, pilgrim and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of faith and devotion
data.etymology: Hajurah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pious, devout, pilgrim.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hajurah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_urdu.name: حجورة

in_pashto.name: حجورة

Hajurah symbolizes devotion to faith, commitment to one's belief, and the strength to embark on a spiritual journey that requires a great deal of physical and emotional endurance.

Through the physical act of making the pilgrimage to Mecca, Hajurah embodies the spiritual journey towards self-improvement and growth. The name serves as a reminder of the Muslim's belief in God and the importance of following His commandments and seeking His pleasure above all else. The name 'Hajurah' is a powerful symbol of the transformative power of faith and the search for spiritual fulfillment through the practice of Islamic traditions and rituals.
